comments.dependencies: Frontend vendor libraries served to the browser. The build.xml Ant target copies these from node_modules into resources/{js,css,fonts}/external (scripts/copy-vendor-libs.js) - split by file type so a stylesheet's relative url()s to its own images/fonts still resolve; fontawesome's webfonts are the one exception, pulled into resources/fonts/external with a rewritten url() since nothing else needed its own css-adjacent font folder.
comments.font-awesome: Consolidated onto @fortawesome/fontawesome-free@7.3.1 everywhere (previously split 4.7.0/5.7.2). All icon markup was rewritten to explicit fas/far classes and current icon names (see shims.yml-derived mapping in the PR) - no v4-shims.css dependency.
comments.d3: Single d3, pinned to 3.5.17 (the last 3.x). Everything that uses d3 here targets the v3 API: d3sparql.js (vendored, third-party), d3sparqlsettings*.js (d3.layout.force, d3.xhr, d3.scale.ordinal) and templates/sparql.html. items/permanentItems used to load d3 v5 with the same code, which has none of those APIs (removed in v4). Moving to d3 7 means rewriting d3sparql.js and the settings scripts.
comments.jquery: jQuery 3.7.1 -> 4.0.0 (+ jquery-migrate 3.6.0 -> 4.0.2). Removed APIs used by first-party code ($.trim, .bind, $(window).load) were replaced with native/.on equivalents; jquery-migrate 4 stays loaded as a safety net for the vendored plugins (jQuery UI 1.13, DataTables 1.13, slick-carousel, virtual-keyboard) - check the browser console for migrate warnings. Bootstrap is deliberately still 3.4.1 (last 3.x): 5.x needs a template-wide markup migration. datatables.net/-bs were bumped 1.10.9 -> 1.13.11 earlier to close a high-severity prototype-pollution/XSS advisory.
comments.leaflet: Leaflet 0.7.7 -> 1.9.4 and leaflet-search 2.3.3 -> 4.0.0. The vendored mapbox.js 2.3.0 (a Leaflet 0.7 bundle) and its mapbox.css are removed: the app only ever used plain Leaflet APIs (L.map, L.tileLayer pointed at the Mapbox styles API, L.geoJSON, L.control) and never L.mapbox.*. The local leaflet/leaflet-search/leaflet.fullscreen CSS copies are replaced by the vendored package CSS.
comments.cdn: Everything loaded from a CDN has been vendored through npm (bootstrap-slider, vis-timeline, vis-network, alpheios CSS). The only remaining external load is Google Charts (gstatic loader.js), which fetches further scripts at runtime and can't be vendored as a single file. .npmrc sets legacy-peer-deps because vis-network@7.10.2 (vis-data ^6) and vis-timeline@8 (vis-data >=8) peer ranges conflict, while we only ship their self-contained prebuilt bundles.

scripts.deploy:dev: ant && EXISTDB_SERVER=http://localhost:8080 EXISTDB_USER=admin EXISTDB_PASS= xst package install local-files build/*.xar
